apps.name: AI Usage Tracker
apps.subtitle: Track AI usage across multiple providers
apps.localizedDescription: Standalone multi-provider AI usage monitor for Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Grok, Google AI Studio, and OpenCode Go with secure local credential storage and device pairing.
apps.versionDescription:
In the sidebar, a row now shows a red dot and "Sign-in needed" when one of its accounts must sign in again, and an amber dot when an account's usage is out of date, instead of looking the same as a provider with no data.
The active top bar page tab, Sync Devices, Check Now, and the Add Account buttons now use pure white text and icons, and the sidebar Add Account plus icon matches the top bar's bold stroke.
Dropdown labels and unselected menu options across Settings and modals, as well as the group modal's selected account count, now match the off-white font color of ghost buttons.
On desktop, the account name and email on account cards are now vertically centered relative to the provider icon and action buttons.
On the Usage page, provider icons now match the 28px size of Dashboard account cards and vertically center with the drag reorder grip.
In the Usage Notifications modal, the provider name stands out in bold white, quota rows on phones stay on a single line without a divider line matching desktop, and limits are labeled 5-HOUR, 7-DAY, and 30-DAY without repeating the quota period note.
On phones, the sidebar's Account and Group buttons have 10px corners and a larger, bolder label, like the desktop top bar's.
On desktop, the top bar's page switch and its Group and Account buttons are now 44px tall, the same as the Settings page's buttons, with the page tabs grown to match and the same padding and edge as those buttons.
Buttons on the Settings page and in the Paseo Bridge window now have 10px corners and slightly bolder text, matching the top bar's Group and Account buttons. In the dark theme, the ghost Settings buttons and the Group buttons in the top bar and sidebar use an off-white label.
In Settings, Check Now is green like the Update button it turns into, as is Regenerate in the Paseo Bridge window, and "Version X available" shows an amber dot instead of a red one, since a new version is not an error.
The sync status at the bottom of the sidebar now reads "All accounts synced:" with the time in bold white on the line under it, a larger status dot that turns amber when some accounts are out of date, and both lines lined up and centred beside Refresh all. The separate "accounts out of date" note is gone: the sidebar rows, the Action needed card and each account card already flag those accounts.
On iPhone, the app now opens with its icon centred on black, the same startup screen as Android, instead of a blank screen.
The sidebar's Refresh all button now has the same grey outline as the other buttons, and the Group buttons in the sidebar and the top bar now use the same dark fill and white icon and text as Refresh all and the Settings page's buttons. The phone's menu button uses the same grey outline and dark fill too.
On phones, the sidebar's resize dots now sit midway between the list's scroll bar and the sidebar edge, instead of touching the scroll bar.
The first page in the top bar and the phone bottom bar is now called "Dashboard" instead of "Accounts", its tooltip reads "View all your AI accounts, their limits, and reset times", and its subtitle now names weekly and session limits.
On desktop, the top bar's add buttons now read "Group" and "Account" beside their icons, matching the phone sidebar.
On desktop, "Accounts synced …" and the Refresh all button now sit at the bottom of the sidebar, as on phones, instead of in the top bar, below a line that separates them from the account list.
The New group buttons in the top bar and the sidebar now show stacked layers with a plus, instead of a person with a plus that read as "invite someone".
A signed-out account card now shows one message with a single "Sign in again" button (or "Reconnect Cloud Usage" for Google AI Studio), and its empty usage area says "Usage appears after you sign in."
Account card status chips now say what is wrong: "Signed out", "Out of date" (with the Refresh button highlighted) or "Refresh failed", instead of "Auth needed" and "Action needed". A failed refresh's message now has a Retry button beside it.
On phones, the menu and close buttons, the sidebar's Account and Group buttons, the rename pen and the % Left / % Used switch now have larger tap areas.
On phones, the switch beside the page title now reads "% Left / % Used" instead of "L / U", and moves to its own line when a long group name leaves no room.
In the sidebar, the 5H / 7D labels above each meter are slightly larger and easier to read.
In Settings, the account update interval setting is now labeled "Account Refresh".
In the device sync modal, the kicker is now "Sync devices over local network", the title heading is scaled to fit on one line on phones, and the settings toggle is labeled "Also Transfer Settings & Layout".
In Settings, the device pairing button is now labeled "Sync Devices".
Subheaders under the Accounts, Usage, and Settings page titles now clearly describe what each page monitors and manages.
On desktop, the tooltips on the Accounts, Usage, and Settings switch buttons now describe each page in detail and align to the switch's left edge, and the % Left display mode tooltip now extends all the way to the right edge matching % Used.
On the Usage page, each card's total now says what it measures ("used this week" under the percentage), so it is no longer mistaken for the amount left.
In the sidebar, when a narrow width causes meter pairs to stack into two lines (such as for Grok's 7D limits), all provider rows now stack their meters into two lines uniformly.
In the sidebar, group rows for accounts with monthly limits (such as ChatGPT Free) now label the second meter "30D" instead of "7D", matching the dashboard.
In the sidebar, Grok rows now label their two limits "7D Bot" and "7D Grok" instead of "GROKBOT" and "GROK", matching the dashboard.
On Grok account cards, the GrokBot limit is now labeled "Bot" to avoid repeating the provider name.
On the Accounts page, the Next reset card now names the model after the limit for Antigravity ("5H Gemini Antigravity", with Other or Argon) and for the Grok Bot limit ("7D Bot Grok"); the plain Grok limit still reads "7D Grok".
On mobile, the sidebar's account and group cards now sit closer to the left edge, with the provider icon and the right padding matching, and the cards' right edge moved closer to the resize dots.
Antigravity now uses Google's official full-color Antigravity icon. Google AI Studio still uses the Google G.
Tooltips on the Dashboard, Usage, and Settings switch buttons now anchor individually (left, center, and right), preventing adjacent tooltips from overlapping.
Checkboxes in device sync, Google AI Studio, and usage alert settings now use the app's solid purple theme across all browsers, replacing washed-out platform accent colors.
In Settings, selected items in the Appearance and Account Refresh dropdowns now highlight in purple matching modal dropdowns.
Sidebar rows no longer squeeze together and overlap when the list is longer than the window; the list scrolls instead.
The Paseo Bridge window no longer stays on "Loading…" forever when its details can't be loaded; it shows why, with a Retry button.
On desktop, the Accounts page now shows its loading placeholder instead of a blank page while accounts load.
Keyboard focus is now visible on the account card's logo, the phone menu and close buttons, dialog close buttons and the account card menu's items.
On phones, the Action Needed card's "Requires action" text no longer runs under the count.
Usage percentages in the sidebar, on account cards and on the Usage page are easier to read: the red in the dark theme and the green and amber in the light theme now meet accessible contrast.
Dragging a row in the sidebar now reorders the accounts on the Accounts and Usage pages immediately, together with the sidebar.
Sidebar group rows no longer show a "Group" pill, since they already sit under the Groups heading.
On mobile, account cards no longer show the percentage pill when collapsed.
